meta.title: JGC Flight Planner — Your next chapter, closer
meta.description: Plan your Life Status Points journey and explore flight costs with clearly labeled, unverified demo estimates.
nav.noteBody: A little planning for the places you want to go.
dashboard.title: Your next chapter, closer.
dashboard.description: A clear view of your Life Status Points. A smarter way to plan ahead.
settings.title: Your planning values
settings.description: Manual demo values for this session. Your target is a personal goal, not a verified JGC requirement.
validation.balance: Use whole numbers: current LSP must be 0 or more and target must be greater than 0.
progress.label: Progress toward target LSP
simulator.title: Make your next flight count.
simulator.description: Explore an itinerary and see its potential, before you book.
form.airfareHint: Full itinerary, including taxes and fees
form.carrierHint: Two-character code · applies to each segment
form.eligibilityHint: Airports alone do not confirm eligibility. Choose “Unknown” if unsure.
form.correctErrors: Please correct the highlighted fields before estimating.
form.disclaimer: Unverified demo estimates. No official entitlements.
validation.dateOrder: Return date cannot be before departure.
validation.airfare: Enter a whole JPY amount of 0 or more, within the safe integer limit.
result.title: Your flight outlook
result.emptyBody: Add your flight details to explore estimated points, cost efficiency, and a segment-by-segment breakdown.
result.loadingBody: Requesting a demo estimate from the policy engine.
result.noBalanceChange: Nothing is added to your balance. Simulate freely and plan at your own pace.
result.roundedCost: JPY / LSP · rounded to nearest yen
result.pendingNote: Unknown eligibility or an unsupported route leaves the total pending. Known segment estimates are shown below.
result.balanceUnchanged: Simulation only. Your current LSP balance stays the same.
policy.title: Built for planning. Awaiting policy verification.
policy.description: All flight calculations are unverified demo estimates, not confirmed JAL entitlements. Eligibility is entered manually. Life Status Points (LSP) are separate from annual FLY ON Points.
policy.usage: Usage: demonstration only. Eligibility is supplied manually.
policy.warning: Unverified demonstration data only. This estimate does not represent verified JAL LSP rules. Eligibility is supplied manually and is not verified.
errors.configuration: The API URL is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL and restart the frontend.
errors.timeout: The estimate request timed out. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the estimate API. Check that the backend is running and allows this frontend origin, then try again.
errors.format: The API returned an unsupported estimate format. Please try again after checking the backend version.
errors.http: Estimate failed (HTTP {status}). Please try again shortly.
errors.validation: Please check the itinerary (HTTP {status}), update your inputs and try again.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
